The Role of Curated Data in Machine Learning Outcomes

Investigated how intentional data curation — cleaning, standardization, label QA, and documentation — measurably improves six ML outcomes: accuracy (+23%), fairness (+31%), generalization (+18%), interpretability, efficiency (3×), and reproducibility.
